Promotion is valid from 17 June 2026 to 31 January 2027.
Promotion is valid for new American Express card members only.
For new-to-American Express card members
: Apply for the AMEX Platinum Credit Card, pay the annual fee (S$327 incl. GST) and make a min. spend of S$4,000 within the first 3 months of card approval to be eligible for rewards.
